purpose: Agent-owned candidate ideas for autonomous product evolution. Candidates are not commitments until promoted to backlog/tasks.json with acceptance criteria and validation evidence.

scoring.userImpact: How much clearer, more useful, or easier the mock finance workflow becomes.
scoring.presentationValue: How much the change improves a credible demo or portfolio presentation.
scoring.evidence: Support from user-flow observation, browser checks, test gaps, or established UX quality criteria.
scoring.risk: Implementation, regression, and scope risk; lower is better.

lastDiscovery.summary: Two consecutive clean audits (003/004). IDEA-006/010 deferred as low cosmetic; release readiness ready.

candidates.title: Clarify monthly spending patterns with an accessible visual breakdown
candidates.hypothesis: A compact, accessible category visualization could make the monthly story more immediately understandable than a list alone.

candidates.title: Improve first-use guidance and demo narrative
candidates.hypothesis: Lightweight explanation of the mock account, goal workflow, and recommendation logic could reduce ambiguity for first-time viewers.

candidates.title: Strengthen state feedback across the dashboard
candidates.hypothesis: More deliberate loading, saving, empty, and error feedback could make the product feel more dependable in a live demo.

candidates.title: Document local run and operational readiness
candidates.hypothesis: A first-time operator cannot confidently demo the app without explicit install/env/seed/run steps in README.

candidates.title: Make discretionary cut suggestions visible in the default demo path
candidates.hypothesis: Default on-pace seed hides the recommendation list; a documented or seeded behind-pace path could make that MVP capability easier to demo.
candidates.notes: Deferred: EVOLVE-004 demo tips cover goal adjustment; final RELEASE_READINESS verifier judged non-necessary.

candidates.title: Polish focus order across new guide and retry controls
candidates.hypothesis: Explicit focus-visible and logical tab order on DemoGuide and Retry controls would strengthen accessibility evidence.
candidates.notes: Reopened; tab-order quirks on native month/date still observed in USABILITY-AUDIT-001. Deferred after AUDIT-003/004: low cosmetic, not required for presentation-ready release.

candidates.title: Audit and strengthen control, label, and content distinction
candidates.hypothesis: A systematic novice-user audit can reveal ambiguous buttons, inputs, labels, helper text, hierarchy, and guidance that functional tests alone did not catch.
candidates.notes: Refined into UX-001 after live audit evidence (month clarity + empty-state honesty + CTA hierarchy).

candidates.title: Name the pace/recommendation month and fix false empty-cut copy
candidates.hypothesis: Surfacing analyticsYearMonth and honest empty-gap messaging removes the July-vs-pace contradiction that blocks first-use comprehension.

candidates.title: Field-adjacent goal validation and stronger input affordances
candidates.hypothesis: Moving errors next to fields and strengthening input borders would reduce trial-and-error on goal edit.

candidates.title: Distinguish essential vs discretionary in category breakdown
candidates.hypothesis: Quiet visual distinction could connect category bars to recommendation eligibility without new math.
candidates.notes: Presentation-only; defer until month/empty-state clarity ships. Deferred after AUDIT-003/004: low cosmetic, not required for presentation-ready release.

candidates.title: Replace minor-units jargon in cut suggestion explanations
candidates.hypothesis: Novices cannot parse '4500 minor units'; plain-language dollar explanations matching visible cut amounts will make recommendations understandable.
candidates.notes: Presentation-layer formatting of already-returned minor amounts; no formula change.

candidates.title: Scope or label transaction history relative to selected month
candidates.hypothesis: When Monthly position is empty for August but the table still lists July rows, users think activity belongs to the selected month.
